title: Drunken Noodles
steps: Prepare the rice noodles according to package instructions, then drain them thoroughly and set aside.
Whisk together the light soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce, and sugar in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large wok over high heat and stir-fry the garlic and chilli for 20 seconds.
Add the sliced sirloin steak and stir-fry for 1 minute until browned, then add the broccoli.
Tip in the prepared noodles and sauce, stir-frying for 1 to 2 minutes until piping hot.
Stir through the Thai basil leaves, turn off the heat, and serve immediately.
